proof: TOWN OF LUNENBURG, GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS, `SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS`, FISCAL YEAR 2019 -- the Town Accountant's schedule. THE PRINTED HEADER, VERBATIM, READ OFF FY2019's OWN PAGES and not inherited from another year: `PROGRAM NAME | APPROPRIATED FORWARD | TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE | TOTAL EXPENDED | TOTAL ENCUMBERED | BALANCE TO REVENUE`, repeated at the top of pp.32 and 34 of the PDF (printed pages 30 and 32). THIS FILE IS PART OF THE RUN, NOT THE WHOLE OF IT: pp.32, 33 and 34 of the PDF, 42 department lines built from 97 printed line items. The run continues to pp.35-36 and the GRAND TOTAL and the `fwd`/`srt`/`rft` legends are printed at the foot of p36, which is NOT in this file -- so nothing here is checked against the run's grand total and this file declares a row identity instead. EVERY PAGE IS A PHOTOGRAPH: pdfplumber returns 0 words for all three, each carries exactly one JBIG2Decode image at 4400x3400 (400 dpi, the best resolution in this archive) and /Rotate 270. pdfminer cannot decode JBIG2 -- `get_data()` returns the raw embedded stream and PIL refuses it -- so the page was rendered upright at native resolution with pypdfium2 and read. NO RECOGNITION WAS USED and the OCR cache for these pages is not a starting point: it lost the top of every page and 47 rows of table-corrections.csv exist to patch it. WHAT PROVES THIS READING, and it is two independent things, both computed before the file was written: (1) each of the 42 departments foots its own printed line items in all four of the columns it prints them in -- APPROPRIATED FORWARD, TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE, TOTAL EXPENDED, TOTAL ENCUMBERED -- 0 failures; and (2) each of the 42 departments satisfies TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE - TOTAL EXPENDED - TOTAL ENCUMBERED = BALANCE TO REVENUE -- 0 failures. A wrong digit anywhere breaks one or the other. Nothing was adjusted to make either close and nothing here is attested: on these three pages the document foots itself everywhere it is checkable. A `fwd` OR `srt` MARKER IS A LINE OF THE APPROPRIATED FORWARD COLUMN, NOT AN ANNOTATION, and it is carried here as its own line item with a `forward` / `salary_reserve_transfer` column beside the appropriated_forward one: 11 `fwd` lines summing to 397,152.36 and 3 `srt` lines summing to 11,775.60 on these three pages. THE LEGENDS THAT WOULD CHECK THEM ARE ON p36 AND ARE NOT READ HERE -- those two figures are partial sums of a run that continues, and must not be compared with the printed legend until pp.35-36 are read. TWO FILES, TWO GRAINS OF ONE TABLE, AND THEY MUST NEVER BE ADDED TOGETHER: `fy2019-p32-appropriations.csv` holds the 42 DEPARTMENT lines and `fy2019-p32-appropriations-detail.csv` holds the 97 LINE ITEMS beneath them. WHAT THE PAGE DOES NOT PRINT IS RECORDED AS BLANK, NEVER AS ZERO: 14 department lines print no TOTAL ENCUMBERED cell at all (Banking Charges, Town Clerk's Salary, Finance Committee, Police Lock-Up, Injury Leave, Mtc of Town Radios, Comp. Radio Watch Personnel, Emergency Management, Inspector Weights & Measures, Inspector of Animals, Nursing Service Nashoba, Nashoba Membership, Highway Labor, Town Barn Maintenance); `Art 11/07 ATM Master Plan Consulting` (p33) prints NO TOTAL EXPENDED cell; and two line items print no TOTAL EXPENDED -- Emergency Management :: Other Expenses and General Health Expense :: Other Expenses, both on p34. Every one of the 42 department lines DOES print a BALANCE TO REVENUE. FUND_NUMBER IS THE PRINTED POSITION, not the label: these pages print `Other Expenses` twelve times on p32 alone, and `Payroll` and `Payroll-Clerical` under several departments, so a key built from the label cannot tell two rows apart. TWO FIGURES THAT LOOK LIKE MISREADS AND ARE NOT: Conservation Commission :: Payroll is EXPENDED 48,928.56 against an appropriation of 48,927.06 -- an overspend of 1.50 -- and Fire Department :: Payroll-Firefighters/Daymen is EXPENDED 726,424.50 against 610,775.10. Both are required by their own department's printed total.
